newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE SAYS IVO MERGER WOULD BE GOOD.
newsitem.headline: NESTE SAYS IVO MERGER WOULD BE GOOD.

text.p: Finnish oil, energy and chemicals group Neste president Jukka Viinanne said on Tuesday a merger with power group Imatran Voima is an option being probed by the government, and would be good for shareholders.
The ministry of trade and industry said earlier it was investigating a broader shareholder base for Neste and Imatran Voima as well as co-development of the two companies.
"Our perception is that a merger is one option being investigated here," Viinanen told Reuters by telephone.
"We feel it would be good for shareholders ... and also for consumers and the state," Viinanen said.

He said a merged group would have opportunities to expand production of natural gas, which is a growing energy business area, and that a larger group could compete better on the Nordic market, "and later even beyond".
He said combining IVO and Neste would create a bigger group than Swedish Vattenfall but smaller than Norsk Hydro and German rivals measured by assets.
Asked what other options than a merger of IVO and Neste would be studied, Viinanen gave no details but said "what point would there be in a context of this scale to create smaller units?"
